title: Tracecat 1.5.0-alpha.1
body_markdown:
## Case management


- fix(cases): Number case panel hotkeys in tab order ([#3985](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3985) )
- test(cases): Cover deleting an already-removed case field ([#4077](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4077) )
- fix(cases): Reject invalid timestamp case field values ([#4079](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4079) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Sort the tables list by name, created or updated ([#4064](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4064) )
- fix(tables): Render quoted JSON and text column defaults ([#4078](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4078) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Validate first-class LLM provider keys before save ([#3922](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3922) )
- fix(agents): Classify managed LLM provider and gateway outages ([#4026](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4026) )
- fix(agents): Classify missing provider credentials as a user error ([#4073](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4073) )
- fix(agents): Classify Bedrock AssumeRole denials as user errors ([#4080](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4080) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(mcp): Fix workflow and action descriptions in MCP authoring ([#4000](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4000) )
- fix(mcp): Request offline_access when clients omit scope ([#4071](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4071) )


## Integrations


- fix(integrations): Send PKCE for custom OAuth providers ([#4062](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4062) )


## API


- fix(api): Return 400 for invalid workflow control flow instead of 500 ([#3797](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3797) )
- fix(api): Return 422 for malformed secret IDs ([#4074](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4074) )
- fix(api): Return 400 for security-key sign-in without keys ([#4075](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4075) )
- fix(api): Skip locked API key last_used_at writes ([#4076](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4076) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Keep case count visible and rename search modes ([#3977](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3977) )
- feat(ui): Show build details in platform settings ([#4069](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4069) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Deny same-account sts:AssumeRole on the Fargate executor ([#4082](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4082) )


**Full changelog** :[1.4.0...1.5.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.4.0...1.5.0-alpha.1)
